name: ARViewz
author: arviewz

sections.description:
This plugin enables WordPress users to seamlessly integrate ARViewz features into their websites. With ARViewz, users can add interactive 3D models and augmented reality experiences to their products, enhancing the overall user experience.

Third-Party Services

This plugin uses the following third-party service to provide its functionality:

ARViewz API

– Service Description: The ARViewz plugin relies on the ARViewz API to fetch and display 3D models on WooCommerce product pages.
– Service URL: ARViewz API
– Terms of Use: ARViewz Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy: ARViewz Privacy Policy

Under the following circumstances, the plugin will reach out to the ARViewz API:
– When configuring the plugin settings to fetch available 3D models.
– When displaying 3D models on the WooCommerce product pages.

By using this plugin, you agree to the terms and conditions of the ARViewz API as outlined above.

Included Libraries

This plugin includes the Select2 library for enhanced select elements.

– Unminified Source: The unminified source code of Select2 is included in the plugin under assets/js/select.full.js and assets/css/select.full.css.
– Minified Source: The minified version is also available in assets/js/select.min.js and assets/css/select.min.css for optimized performance.

For more information and the latest updates, visit the Select2 GitHub repository.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, WooCommerce is required for this plugin to work.

How do I add a 3D model to my product?

To add a 3D model:
1. Navigate to the ARViewz > Product screen in the WordPress admin panel.
2. Select the “Add 3D Model” option.
3. Choose the desired 3D model from the available list.

How can I add the ARViewz key in settings?

  1. Copy your ARViewz from ARViewz website setting > ARViewz key.
  2. Go to the ARViewz plugin settings in the WordPress admin area.
  3. Paste copied ARView key in input and save.

Is ARViewz compatible with all devices?

ARViewz supports a wide range of devices, including iOS and Android smartphones and tablets. It’s optimized for WebAR, allowing users to experience AR content directly from their browsers without the need for additional apps.

What are the benefits of using ARViewz for my business?

ARViewz enhances customer engagement by providing an interactive shopping experience. This can increase customer confidence, reduce return rates, and ultimately boost sales. Industries such as furniture, wall coverings, tiles, and art have found significant advantages using ARViewz.
